title: Understanding Terminal Velocity
text: Terminal velocity is reached when the force of gravity is balanced by the drag force. At this point, the net force is zero, and the object falls at a constant speed.

title: Formula for Terminal Velocity
text: The formula for terminal velocity $$v_t$$ is given by: $$v_t=\sqrt{(2mg)/(C_d\rho{A})},$$ where $$m$$ is mass, $$g$$ is acceleration due to gravity, $$C_d$$ is the drag coefficient, $$\rho$$ is the density of air, and $$A$$ is the cross-sectional area.

title: Calculate the Terminal Velocity
text: Substitute the given values into the formula: $$m=80.0\, \text{kg}, $$ $$g=9.81\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}**{2}},$$ $$C_d=0.70, $$ $$\rho=1.21\,\tfrac{\text{kg}}{\text{m}**{3}},$$ $$A=0.140\,\text{m}**{2}$$.
